Hi Emma / Pierre / Kenji —

Thanks again for the interest in a cross-region demo of Redwood Inference. We want to make sure we include the right stakeholders (product + infra + execs) from each side and avoid painful timezone back-and-forth. Attaching a short options doc with 3 proposed times (Sched_Options.pdf) and a quick exec availability sheet (Exec_Availabilities.xlsx).

High-level constraints we see from our side:
- Redwood exec (Vivek) can join early PT (before 11:00 PT) or late CET (after 17:00 CET); prefers mornings PT.
- We want product and infra on the call to answer architecture questions (looping Marissa + Stephanie).

Proposed slots (all on Mon/Tue/Wed next week) — I’ve listed local conversions: PT / CET / JST
- Option A: 2026-03-22 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST (Mar 23)
- Option B: 2026-03-22 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST (Mar 23)
- Option C: 2026-03-22 01:30 PT / 10:30 CET / 18:30 JST

Notes on DST: EU is changing clocks later in March; please double-check local calendars — the attached PDF has conversions as of today.

Can you confirm which option works for executives on your side? If none, please send two windows that overlap with the above and we’ll pick the best fit.

Calendar link (temporary): https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123
Attachments: Sched_Options.pdf, Exec_Availabilities.xlsx

Thanks,

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the options and the clear conversions. Quick note from the exec side: our VP can only join windows before 11:00 PT on Monday–Wednesday. She’s also traveling the week after (changes in travel schedule), so we need to lock this week if possible.

Also: we have an internal concern around the EU DST change that Pierre flagged — if the meeting falls the week the clocks change, our calendar will auto-shift and could cause confusion for attendees in EU. We’d prefer a time that doesn’t rely on a DST boundary day for the EU participants.

Right now the only realistic overlap is Option C for us, but I need to check one final person (Kenji) about late evening JST.
